official.deadline_central_display: No single university-wide deadline: Tsinghua states applicants are highly recommended to apply before mid-December and that the exact date is set by each school or department
official.deadline_note: The CGS Type B deadline is set by each school or department of Tsinghua University; the department informs a candidate by email when a recommendation is possible, and missing that departmental deadline means missing some CGS Type B programmes.
official.application_cycle: 2026 cycle page published November 2025 for 2026 award, recommending applications before mid-December 2025; the live page now notes the scholarship for 2027 is coming soon
official.status_note: The displayed page is the 2026 Chinese Government Scholarship page, published November 2025, and it states 'Scholarship for 2027 is coming soon'; applications are recommended well before mid-December each cycle.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tsinghua states Full CGS covers 'tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance'; the CSC coverage guide lists tuition fees as item 1 of the coverage.
benefits: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
Stipend: CNY 3,000 per month for master's students; CNY 3,500 per month for doctoral students (undergraduates: CNY 2,500 per month)
Comprehensive medical insurance: CNY 800 per person per year; CNY 400 per person for programmes lasting less than six months
Partial CGS includes one or some items from the full coverage
Tsinghua's financial aid system also includes tuition scholarships (Beijing Government Scholarship and Tsinghua University Tuition Scholarship), assistantships and awards
The distribution of CGS will be adjusted according to the policies and regulations of higher authorities
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China, and be in good health both mentally and physically
Be a bachelor's degree holder under the age of 35 when applying for master's programmes
Be a master's degree holder under the age of 40 when applying for doctoral programmes (bachelor's holders pursuing doctoral degrees at Tsinghua may apply for CGS Type A or B if eligible)

Have acquired Chinese proficiency of HSK Level 4 when applying for Chinese-taught master's or doctoral programmes (graduates of Chinese-taught degrees at Chinese universities may instead provide proof of Chinese-taught instruction from the previous degree-awarding institution)
Have been pre-admitted by Tsinghua and recommended for CGS by the pre-admitted schools or departments - otherwise the application will not be considered or processed
Have not been offered other scholarships for prospective graduate study at Tsinghua or been nominated as a CGS candidate by another university
Meet other Type B requirements such as applicable programmes, majors and nationalities
CGS Type B is not open to joint-degree graduate programmes
Type B is open to prospective students only; current Tsinghua students without CGS cannot apply for Type B
requirements: Apply for graduate programmes at Tsinghua University for pre-admission first (online at yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin) and reach the school or department for a recommendation
Complete the CGS online application in the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System when instructed by the pre-admitted school or department, and keep in touch by e-mail
Documents are submitted online; CGS applicants do not need to mail hard copies to Tsinghua University
Applications without the recommendation of schools or departments will not be processed
Prepare documents well in advance, considering their period of validity
documents: Chinese Government Scholarship Application form (filled in and downloaded online via the CSC system)
Pre-admission result and the school or department recommendation (agency number provided by the department)
A clear scanned copy of the information page of an ordinary passport whose validity covers more than 12 months from the expected start date
Diploma and notarized photocopy of the highest education certificate (or certificate of expected graduation / student status for current students)
Academic transcripts with notarised translations where not in Chinese or English
Language qualification certificates (HSK for Chinese-taught programmes; IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent per university requirement for programmes taught in other languages)
A study or research plan in Chinese or English (no fewer than 1,000 words for postgraduates)
Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors for postgraduate applicants
Works (videos, paintings) for arts or design programmes
Foreigner Physical Examination Form photocopy covering all items, with the attending physician's signature, hospital seal and sealed photograph
Valid Certificate of Non-Criminal Record or Police Clearance Certificate, usually issued within 6 months prior to submission
selection_criteria: Tsinghua University selects CGS candidates based on school or department recommendations, requirements of higher authorities and the annual number limit
Applying for CGS through Tsinghua is highly competitive; Tsinghua usually selects candidates from pre-admitted applicants of remarkable merit
The CSC organises designated universities and experts to examine applicants' eligibility and academic performance before finalising the short list

Annual Review is strictly required for all CGS holders (academic performance, learning attitude, attendance, student conduct, rewards and punishments); the scholarship is suspended or terminated if not passed
coverage: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
Monthly stipend (CNY 3,000 for master's, CNY 3,500 for doctoral students)
Comprehensive medical insurance (CNY 800 per person per year)
application_method: Step 1: apply for pre-admission at Tsinghua and obtain the school or department recommendation at yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin
Step 2: fill in, submit and download the CGS Online Application form via the CSC system when informed by the department
Step 4: Tsinghua nominates the selected candidates to the CSC
Step 5: the CSC organises expert review and approval, and notifies the results to Tsinghua
official.application_route: Win Tsinghua pre-admission and a school or department recommendation first, then complete the CGS application in the CSC system when the department instructs; Tsinghua nominates and the CSC makes the final decision.
official.study_mode: Full-time (Tsinghua's financial aid system is established for outstanding full-time international graduate students)
official.citizenship_residency: Be a citizen of a country other than the People's Republic of China and be in good health both mentally and physically.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is designed for international students; citizens of the PRC are excluded.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicable programmes, majors and nationalities depend on the Type B programme rules and must be checked with the school or department scholarship contact in advance; CGS Type B is not open to joint-degree graduate programmes, and many high-tuition programmes do not participate in Type B recommendation.
official.research_requirement: A study or research plan in Chinese or English is required by the CSC application (no fewer than 1,000 words/characters for postgraduates).
official.duration: Master's degree: 1-3 years. Doctoral degree: 4-5 years. Tsinghua's FAQ states CGS duration is usually 1-3 academic years for master's and 3-4 academic years for doctoral students; the CSC guide notes CGS also covers a one-year Chinese language preparatory year where applicable.
official.description: The Chinese Government Scholarship is set up by the Chinese government for talented students and scholars to pursue higher education in Chinese universities; the China Scholarship Council, entrusted by China's Ministry of Education, is responsible for the admission, enrolment and administration of CGS recipients. This record covers the Type B route under the CGS-Chinese University Program, in which Tsinghua University nominates candidates.
official.program_type: Chinese Government Scholarship Category Type B (CGS-Chinese University Program) nominated by Tsinghua University to the China Scholarship Council

not_confirmed: travel/airfare coverage (the published coverage list of tuition, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance does not include it)
single university-wide application deadline (each school or department sets its own dates)
exact dates of the 2027 cycle (the page states the 2027 scholarship is coming soon)
Chinese-language requirements for English-taught Tsinghua programmes beyond the general university admission requirement
verification.notes: Tsinghua's Scholarship Application page, Financial Aid System page and scholarship FAQ were read in full on 2026-10-10, together with the China Scholarship Council's official 'Application Guide for Chinese Government Scholarship' page (campuschina.org), which supplies the published stipend figures (master's CNY 3,000, doctoral CNY 3,500 per month) and the insurance amounts. Tsinghua itself publishes the coverage categories without figures and refers applicants to the CSC website.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no direct CGS application at Tsinghua: you must first be pre-admitted through the graduate application portal and then be recommended by your admitting school or department, and only those recommended candidates are nominated to the CSC. The scholarship pays your tuition, gives you free dormitory or an accommodation subsidy, a monthly stipend of CNY 3,000 (master's) or CNY 3,500 (doctoral) and comprehensive medical insurance, but it does not include airfare. Time the pre-admission application well before mid-December because each department sets its own Type B recommendation deadline, and expect the final CSC result only in July or August.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong master's or doctoral applicants under 35/40 respectively from outside China who have a realistic chance of pre-admission to a Tsinghua graduate programme that participates in the Type B recommendation.
application_readiness_checklist: Start the Tsinghua pre-admission application early - departments may close their CGS recommendation before the university-level timeline ends
Answer the scholarship questions in the Tsinghua application portal and declare any other Tsinghua scholarship offer, including its founder and duration
Keep the passport valid for more than 12 months from the expected study start date before completing the CSC application
Schedule the Foreigner Physical Examination Form early: it is valid for only six months
Obtain a Non-Criminal Record certificate within six months of submission, with notarised translation if not in Chinese or English
Confirm with the department's scholarship contact that your programme participates in Type B recommendation, especially for high-tuition programmes
common_rejection_risks: Applying as a current student, as a joint-degree programme applicant, or after being nominated by another university - all disqualify the Type B route
Missing the school or department recommendation, which voids the application regardless of merit
Being unreachable or failing to complete the CSC online application in time, which Tsinghua treats as renouncing the candidacy
Being offered a second scholarship at Tsinghua: CGS cannot be combined with other scholarships (only one-time awards), so an unfair mix weakens the file
Failing the CSC annual review after acceptance, which suspends or terminates the scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Flights to and from China, personal living costs beyond the dormitory or subsidy and stipend, and any programme costs above the CGS expense structure are self-funded; for high-tuition programmes outside Type B recommendation, tuition gaps may also be personal.
document_audit: The HSK certificate route applies only to Chinese-taught programmes; a previous Chinese-taught degree can replace it with proof of Chinese-taught instruction from the previous institution
Physical examination records without the physician's signature, hospital seal or sealed photograph are declared invalid by Tsinghua
A certificate of expected graduation must be used if the final diploma is not yet issued
Prospective-graduation documents in other languages need notarised Chinese or English translations
Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors are required for postgraduate applicants - referees below that rank do not satisfy the CSC rule
alerts: The CGS stipend figures come from the CSC's coverage guide, not from Tsinghua, and Tsinghua notes distribution is adjusted according to higher-authority policies
Type A (bilateral, EU, AUN and similar) is an alternative if the Type B route fails, but you must choose one channel and cannot hold both
If a Type A application is declined, only a few outstanding candidates may be specially reconsidered for Type B, and only while departmental recommendations remain open
A scholarship-holder is selected from pre-admitted applicants of remarkable merit: pre-admission performance is effectively the selection stage
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Pre-apply at yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn, secure the department recommendation, complete the CSC system application when instructed, wait for Tsinghua's nomination and the CSC expert review, with results usually released in July-August.
